Enumerator Coach
  Make an Impact. Support Agriculture. Lead a Team.
 Do you enjoy helping others succeed, solving problems, and making a difference in your community? Are you passionate about agriculture and interested in a role where your communication and leadership skills truly matter?


 Join the National Association of State Departments of Agriculture (NASDA) as an Enumerator Coach and help support the people who collect the agricultural data our nation depends on.


 As an Enumerator Coach, you will lead and support a team of up to 20 Enumerators, helping them confidently complete agricultural surveys with accuracy, professionalism, and consistency. Your guidance will play an important role in ensuring farmers, ranchers, rural communities, and agricultural leaders have access to reliable information they can trust.


 This is more than a coaching position-it's an opportunity to lead, teach, problem-solve, and contribute to the future of American agriculture.


  Why Join NASDA?
 At NASDA, your work has a purpose.


 You'll be part of an organization dedicated to strengthening American food and agriculture communities through policy, partnerships, and public engagement.


 As an Enumerator Coach, you'll have the opportunity to:


 
  Make a difference by supporting accurate agricultural data collection.
  Lead and mentor others as you coach a team of Enumerators.
  Build valuable professional skills in leadership, communication, training, and problem-solving.
  Work independently while staying connected to a supportive team.
  Stay connected to agriculture and the farmers, ranchers, and rural communities we serve.
  Enjoy competitive pay and a positive work environment.
  Develop skills and experience that can support your long-term career growth.
 
  About NASDA
 The National Association of State Departments of Agriculture (NASDA) is a nonpartisan, nonprofit association representing the elected and appointed commissioners, secretaries, and directors of state departments of agriculture.


 NASDA enhances American food and agriculture communities through policy, partnerships, and public engagement.


 We believe our mission is strongest when we have passionate, dependable people working alongside us. We strive to create a positive work environment where employees feel valued, supported, and proud of the work they do.


  About the Role
 As an Enumerator Coach, you will serve as a key resource for Enumerators throughout the data-collection process. Reporting to an assigned NASDA Manager, you will provide coaching, quality control, technical assistance, and ongoing training to a team of up to 20 Enumerators.


 You'll help your team stay on track, answer questions, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure surveys are completed accurately and efficiently.


  What You'll Do
 Your responsibilities will include:


 
  Review completed survey forms, questionnaires, and related materials for accuracy and completeness.
  Coach, support, and provide ongoing training to Enumerators throughout data collection.
  Serve as a resource for Enumerators by answering technical and procedural questions.
  Help identify and resolve problems using sound judgment and critical-thinking skills.
  Communicate regularly with the NASDA Enumerator Manager and assigned Enumerators.
  Complete surveys as needed while effectively managing your own workload and team responsibilities.
  Monitor data-collection progress and support quality-control efforts.
  Prepare and present training sessions for groups of 40+ Enumerators on a quarterly basis.
  Help create a positive, professional, and productive experience for the Enumerators you support.
 
  What We're Looking For
 You don't have to be an agricultural expert to succeed in this position. We're looking for someone who is dependable, organized, confident communicating with others, and genuinely interested in helping people succeed.


 The ideal candidate is someone who:


 
  Has a high school diploma plus one year of college or relevant work experience.
  Has experience with data collection.
  Thinks critically and can make sound decisions independently.
  Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
  Is comfortable speaking to and training groups.
  Builds positive relationships easily and enjoys working with people.
  Can coach and encourage others while holding them accountable to quality standards.
  Is self-motivated and able to work independently.
  Works well in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  Is comfortable learning and using new technology.
  Has an interest in agriculture, rural communities, or serving agricultural producers.
 
  Additional Requirements
 
  Availability to work approximately 20–30 hours per week. Occasional weekend work may be required.
  Reliable transportation and the ability to travel intermittently throughout the year.
  Ability to walk unassisted for up to 100 yards.
  Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds.
  Availability to attend quarterly in-person training, which may require travel of up to 350 miles.
  Ability to prepare and deliver training to groups of 40 or more Enumerators.
  A private home-office area suitable for completing work responsibilities.
  Ability to operate and navigate an iPad, use email, and learn new technology and job-related processes.
 
  Preferred Experience
 The following experience is a plus:


 
  Agricultural knowledge or experience.
  Sales or customer-service experience.
  Coaching, training, mentoring, or supervisory experience.
  Experience working with farmers, ranchers, agricultural producers, or rural communities.
 
  Ready to Make a Difference?
 If you're someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, sharing knowledge, and supporting American agriculture, we'd love to hear from you.


 Join NASDA and become part of a team whose work helps provide the accurate information that farmers, ranchers, rural communities, and agricultural decision-makers rely on.


 Bring your skills. Share your knowledge. Support agriculture. Make an impact with NASDA.

They are seeking a seasoned Forecasting and Demand Planning Analyst to manage demand forecasting and long-term planning for their Community Support team, ensuring the right resources are in place to meet service level objectives while optimizing costs and productivity.


Responsibilities

Own short-term, mid-term, and long-term demand forecasting across all Global Operations teams and channels (phone, messaging, email, back-office etc.)Design, develop, and maintain statistically robust demand forecasting models using time series and machine learning techniques (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression-based models etc.)Perform trend, seasonality, and variance decomposition; detect structural breaks, outliers, and demand anomaliesQuantify forecast uncertainty through confidence intervals, error distributions, and bias analysisPerform scenario modeling for peak demand periods, product launches, growth initiatives, and unplanned demand eventsContinuously assess model performance using statistical accuracy metrics (MAPE, RMSE, MAE, bias etc)Establish model governance standards, including documentation, validation, back-testing, and post-mortem analysisResearch, prototype, and implement new forecasting and optimization techniques as business needs evolvePerform scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to quantify trade-offs between service levels, cost, and utilizationIn partnership with the Analytics and Data Engineering team, design and build scalable planning data pipelines, dashboards, and automate forecasting and capacity models to improve scalability, repeatability, and timelinessUse SQL and Python to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale operational datasets to monitor forecast accuracy, capacity gaps, utilization, and operational riskPresent forecast assumptions, methodologies, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations in clear, executive-ready formats and act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and participate in demand/capacity planning discussions in cross-functional forumsAlign cross-functional stakeholders (Delivery, Product, Finance, HR, and others) to embed planning outputs into execution and operational decision-makingIdentify and implement process improvements, automation, and best practices in the demand and capacity planning area to optimize cost while maintaining or improving customer experience and service-level outcomes
Skills

10+ years of experience in demand forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or applied analyticsBachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative fieldStrong foundation in probability, statistics, and optimizationHands-on experience building and validating forecasting models (time series analysis, exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression, hypothesis testing) and capacity models (Erlang, queueing theory, service-level and utilization modeling)Strong understanding of contact center metrics (AHT, ASA, service level, shrinkage, occupancy); experience supporting large-scale, multi-site, or global contact center environments preferredAdvanced analytical skills with strong proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python and data visualization tools such as TableauStrong business acumen with the ability to balance cost efficiency and customer experience outcomesExcellent communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder influence skills; ability to explain complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiencesComfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, and highly dynamic environmentsStrong understanding of contact center metrics (AHT, ASA, service level, shrinkage, occupancy); experience supporting large-scale, multi-site, or global contact center environments preferredExperience with WFM tools (e.g., NICE, Verint, Aspect) or planning platforms (e.g., Anaplan) preferred

BonusEquityBenefitsEmployee Travel Credits

Airbnb is an online community marketplace for people to list, discover, and book accommodations through mobile phones or the Internet. It was founded in 2008, and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, USA, with a workforce of 5001-10000 employees. Its website is https://www.airbnb.com.

Communication: Clear, concise, and engaging communication across all channels.

Langley AFB, VA / Omaha, Nebraska / San Antonio, TX / Rome, NY

EXPANSIA – Air Force/Space Force BU /

Full Time /

Hybrid

Start Date: Immediate 



JHNA, CTSi, and EXPANSIA have come together to form a Defense Technology platform named Aether Aerospace focused on delivering high-impact technologies, technology-enabled services and advanced manufacturing solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense and related national security customers. Backed by Falfurrias Management Partners, the platform brings together deep domain expertise across Army, Navy, and Air Force and Space Force programs, digital engineering, systems integration, and specialized manufacturing capabilities. 

The combined organization operates as a multi-entity aerospace and defense technology and tech-enabled services and manufacturing enterprise positioned for scalable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation

OVERVIEW 



Full-time/Permanent Employee  



Location: Hybrid with SCIF Access in Langley AFB, VA; Offutt AFB/Omaha, NE (will consider JBSA-Lackland and Rome, NY) Candidates must reside within two hours of one of these locations. 

As a Cloud Engineer IV, you will assess cloud infrastructure needs, lead the selection and deployment of OpenStack distributions, and design private cloud solutions integrated with hybrid platform management, identity management, and R&D infrastructure. You will automate build pipelines, migrations, security, and compliance while managing cloud and on-premise networking and leveraging Azure for automation. Responsibilities include implementing and maintaining cloud infrastructure, performing administrative tasks, and providing application support. You will enhance security by applying patches, conducting security reviews, and managing access controls while implementing enterprise monitoring solutions using industry-standard tools. As an emerging authority, you will develop technical solutions to complex problems, drive automation initiatives, and create scalable monitoring solutions, dashboards, and alerts. You will collaborate with business and technology leaders to align cloud strategies with organizational objectives. 

The proposed salary range for this position is $121,900-$162,500. There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, geographic location, education, and certifications. 

RESPONSIBILITIES






Analyze cloud infrastructure needs and participate in selecting and deploying OpenStack distributions 

















Design and implement private cloud infrastructure while ensuring full integration with hybrid cloud platforms and identity management 

















Support automation of build pipelines, migrations, security, and compliance in cloud environments 

















Manage TCP/IP networking in both cloud and on-premise environments 

















Implement and manage enterprise monitoring solutions using industry-standard technologies 

















Perform cloud tool administrative tasks, provide application support, and ensure security compliance 

















Develop monitoring dashboards, escalations, and alerting solutions 

















Transfer knowledge through documentation and training for the software development organization 

















Develop technical solutions to complex problems and determine approaches to assignments with significant latitude 

















Identify opportunities for automation and develop scalable solutions that enhance cloud infrastructure efficiency 

















Provide technical support to operational strategies aligned within your program and initiatives that optimize processes, enhance productivity, and ensure quality across all program functions 

















Ensure 100% of planned hours are worked and recorded 

















Identify and forward to leadership any opportunities that could lead to growth within your work area 

















Participate in growth efforts as requested 

















Ensure all contractual deliverables are met or exceeded to the customer's satisfaction 

















Complete personal PDP and attend staff meetings and Storytime (with the camera on) 

















Build productive and positive professional relationships with clients within your program 

















Execute all contract requirements as assigned in accordance with the contract-specific LCAT and requirements 








KEY QUALIFICATIONS

Clearance: Active TS/SCI 
Education and Years of Experience: Bachelor's degree with 10 years of relevant experience 






Considered an emerging authority in cloud engineering, applying extensive technical expertise 

















Ability to develop technical solutions to complex problems and determine objectives and approaches with considerable latitude 

















Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and security principles 

















Proficiency in scripting or programming for cloud automation 

















Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as PagerDuty, Microsoft OMS, or Azure monitoring solutions. 

















Security +; GICSP, SSCP, or GSEC  




Must be available to support a 24/7 on-call schedule, including nights and weekends. Specific on-call expectations will be defined upon team assignment 





PREFERRED ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS 






Master’s degree preferred 

















Experience with OpenStack distribution selection and deployment 

















Knowledge of private cloud infrastructure design and implementation 

















Understanding of hybrid cloud platform management and identity management integration 

















Familiarity with TCP/IP networking in cloud and on-premise environments 

















Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders 

















Certifications in one or more cloud platforms, such as CompTIA Cloud+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Certified Kubernetes Administrator or similar.  








Aether Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
GOOGLE CLOUD OPERATIONS ENGINEER 




TechTrend is seeking a talented, hands-on Google Cloud Operations Engineer to join our team. Using a modern technology stack and an agile approach, you will have the opportunity to be part of a workforce that is transforming IT through government technology modernization efforts.




In this role, you will be the backbone of our cloud reliability. You will focus on the day-to-day administration, monitoring, security, and performance of our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments. Operating as a hands-on individual contributor, you will take ownership of keeping critical government systems running smoothly, resolving incidents, and optimizing existing infrastructure.




Key Responsibilities:

• Cloud Administration & Operations: Manage the day-to-day operations of enterprise GCP environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and operational stability for a major U.S. Government customer.

• Monitoring & Incident Response: Implement and manage robust monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (e.g., GCP Cloud Operations/Stackdriver, ELK Stack, Splunk). Act as the primary technical responder for infrastructure incidents, troubleshooting and resolving system outages or performance bottlenecks.

• Infrastructure Maintenance (IaC): Maintain and update existing cloud infrastructure using Terraform. Safely apply configuration changes, manage Terraform state, and ensure infrastructure drift is identified and corrected.

• CI/CD & Deployment Support: Maintain and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth, automated, and secure deployments of containerized applications (e.g., Docker, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry) into production.

• Security & Identity Management: Manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles, service accounts, and network security groups. Ensure continuous compliance with strict industry and government standards (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST) through vulnerability patching and security remediation.

• Backup, Recovery & Cost Optimization: Execute routine backups, test disaster recovery procedures, and actively monitor cloud billing to identify and eliminate underutilized resources.




Required Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (Preferred).

• Certifications: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer Certification strongly preferred.

• Cloud Operations Experience: 2 YOE administering, monitoring, and troubleshooting enterprise Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Working knowledge of Terraform to read, update, and deploy infrastructure changes safely within a production environment.

• Modern Tech Stack: Experience operating and troubleshooting containerized workloads, microservices, and serverless solutions (e.g., Cloud Run).

• Cybersecurity & Monitoring: Familiarity with cloud security and monitoring tools (e.g., ELK Stack, Ansible, Nessus, ClamAV, Splunk, Git, and native GCP monitoring).

• Agile Delivery: Experience working in an Agile/DevSecOps environment (Scaled Agile Framework / SAFe knowledge is a plus), utilizing ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) for incident and task management.




Work Location: Remote (able to work out of the Reston office 1-2 times a month)

Travel Requirements: No travel

Job Type: Full-time




Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Life, Short, and Long-term Disability Insurance

• PTO & All federal holidays off

• 401(k) Plan (matching component included)

• Free Gym Access at Headquarters

description:
Company Description



 


Starcom is the world's first standalone media agency, a storied innovator that continues to lead the way for many of the world's best brands.


 


Starcom has long been the professional birthplace and proving ground for marketing leaders – CEOs, CMOs, sales leaders, and technology pioneers – and we continue to drive the industry with peerless talent and relentless innovation.


From the start, we've known that achieving growth for our clients requires understanding and connecting with real people where they live and work, in ways they value.


 


In an AI era, we remain ""Guided By Humanity,"" a phrase that describes our foundational belief that human expertise must remain in the driver's seat, supported by the best processes and technology.


 


With our proprietary capabilities and Publicis Media's industry-leading resources and clout, we create ideas that move people and drive transformative business outcomes for brands.


Overview
We are looking for a Senior AI & Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate intelligent data and AI systems on Azure. You will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and applied AI — developing production-grade pipelines and AI-assisted applications that create measurable business value. 


 


You will be a go-to voice on responsible AI practices, model selection, and evaluation within the team.


Responsibilities
 



 Design and deploy scalable data and AI pipelines on Azure using Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and related services
 Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and AI-assisted workflows that integrate with internal data sources and APIs
 Develop and maintain Python-based applications, microservices, and Azure Container Apps
 Apply prompt engineering techniques and work with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI) to deliver reliable, production-ready AI features
 Implement and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations to connect AI models with enterprise tools and data sources
 Participate in fine-tuning and evaluation of models; contribute to model training workflows where applicable
 Establish best practices for AI observability, evaluation, safety guardrails, and responsible deployment
 Collaborate closely with data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into engineering solutions
 Mentor junior engineers and contribute to architectural decisions

Qualifications
 



 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on AI/ML systems in production
 Strong Python proficiency — data manipulation, API development, async patterns, testing
 Solid experience with Azure cloud services: Azure Data Lake, Azure Container Apps, Azure Blob Storage, Azure OpenAI Service, and related tooling
 Experience with Databricks for large-scale data processing and ML workflows (Delta Lake, Spark, MLflow)
 Practical experience with RAG architectures, vector databases (e.g. Azure AI Search, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), and embedding models
 Working knowledge of prompt engineering — few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, system prompt design, output parsing
 Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool-use / function-calling patterns in LLM applications
 Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)

The Cloud Platform Foundations team builds and operates the core infrastructure behind Temporal Cloud, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and automation. The team owns foundational systems including high availability and disaster recovery, control plane automation, resource and namespace management, and the customer-facing interfaces that shape how users integrate with the platform—from our APIs and CLI to the Terraform provider, SDKs, and Kubernetes operator.

In this role, you'll build systems that directly strengthen Temporal Cloud's resilience, performance, and developer experience. You'll work closely with engineers and product managers to automate critical operations, evolve our multi-tenant control plane, reduce blast radius, improve namespace density, and build safer CI/CD pipelines. If you enjoy solving ambiguous, high-leverage infrastructure problems and creating durable tools that help both customers and engineers move faster, we'd love to meet you.

description:
Position Overview


 


 The Cloud, Engineer - Linux and Automation is responsible for the administration, automation, and continuous improvement of Thrive's Linux-based infrastructure. This role serves as an escalation point for Tier 1 issues and works closely with senior engineers and architects to design and implement repeatable, code-driven infrastructure solutions. The engineer will maintain and develop automation frameworks using Ansible and Terraform, assist with managing Thrive’s private cloud on HPE Morpheus Enterprise and VMware ecosystems, and ensure Ubuntu-based systems are secure, patched, and operating within established SLAs. The ideal candidate brings hands-on IaC experience, strong Linux troubleshooting skills, and a mindset oriented toward automation and operational excellence – all with a security first focus required to avoid unexpected downtime.


 


 

    Responsibilities


 
  Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux systems (primarily Ubuntu) across physical and virtual environments.
  Serve as a Tier 2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents; perform root cause analysis and implement remediation actions.
  Manage and operate virtual machine workloads within HPE Morpheus Enterprise HVM and VMware ESXi, including VM provisioning, lifecycle management, and hypervisor-level troubleshooting.
  Define and enforce standardized build documentation
  Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for configuration management, OS patching, application deployment, and compliance enforcement.
  Write and manage Terraform configurations for infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management.
  Enforce infrastructure-as-code best practices including version control and peer review.
  Maintain and update NetBox as the authoritative source of truth for IP address management (IPAM), DCIM asset records, and network topology documentation.
  Integrate Netbox with IaC tools for automation of routine physical equipment commissioning
  Participate in change management processes, ensuring all changes are documented, reviewed, and approved in alignment with Thrive's ITSM standards.
  Perform routine system health checks, capacity reviews, and performance tuning for Linux servers.
  Maintain and improve internal runbooks, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.
  Collaborate with networking, security, and cloud teams to resolve cross-functional infrastructure issues.
  Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical infrastructure incidents outside of standard business hours.
  Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation and standardization.
 
 
 Requirements
 

 


 
  3-5+ years of hands-on Linux system administration experience with strong proficiency in Ubuntu Linux including systems, networking, storage management, and security hardening
  2+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, specifically Ansible (roles, playbooks, inventories) and Terraform (state management, CI/CD plan/apply workflows)
  Hands-on familiarity with HPE Morpheus Enterprise or similar HVM/KVM platforms for VM provisioning, template management, and self-service automation; experience with VMware vCenter is a strong plus
  Working knowledge of NetBox for IPAM, DCIM, and network source-of-truth management; experience with NetBox API integrations preferred
  Proficiency in scripting languages for automation and tooling development
  Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, and firewall rules as they apply to virtualized and cloud environments
  Familiarity with Git-based version control and collaborative workflows (GitLab or GitHub)
  Ability to diagnose and resolve complex system and infrastructure issues independently and under pressure
  Strong documentation habits - able to produce accurate and maintainable runbooks, topology diagrams, and change records
  Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a diverse workload
  Strong team player - collaborates effectively with peers and cross-functional teams to solve problems
  Proactive, change-oriented mindset - actively seeks process improvements and drives automation-first approaches
  Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related discipline — or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience
  Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM best practices
  Preferred Certifications: Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC-1/LPIC-2) or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA); Red Hat Enterprise Linux Automation with Ansible (RH294) or better; HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003 or 004);
 
 Other:


 
  Work Schedule: Standard business hours with participation in an on-call rotation.
  Remote work eligible
  Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required for datacenter activities. Less than 10%
  Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and credit background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to restricted information. Candidate must be able to pass CJIS clearance for the state of Florida.

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes and GCP
description:
Cardinal Health, a global leader in healthcare innovation, is seeking a Cloud Engineer to help drive the evolution of our enterprise‑scale cloud and CI/CD platforms. Operating in a multi‑cloud, multi‑tenant environment, our platforms support thousands of developers across hundreds of teams, powering mission‑critical workloads across IaaS, PaaS, and CaaS models.



As part of the Serverless Platforms Team, you will help design, build, operate, and continuously improve our cloud‑native and CI/CD platforms—including Kubernetes, serverless runtimes, and the enterprise Harness CI/CD ecosystem. You will work closely with application teams, security partners, and platform stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and repeatable deployment patterns using GitOps, infrastructure as code, and modern DevSecOps practices.



With a strong foundation in cloud‑native development and platform engineering, you will help ensure our platforms are reliable, governed, and easy to consume—while fostering a culture of technical excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, and solving complex platform‑scale challenges, join us to help shape the future of healthcare technology.

Role Summary

As a Cloud Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, deploy, and support containerized and serverless platforms on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and to operate and evolve the enterprise Harness CI/CD platform. You will enable application teams to build, test, and deploy software through standardized, secure, and scalable pipelines while ensuring platform reliability, compliance, and developer experience.

 

Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters and workloads on GKE using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps practices.Operate and support the enterprise Harness CI/CD platform, including build, deploy, and infrastructure pipelines, ensuring availability, reliability, and consistent developer experience across teams.Develop and maintain standardized Harness pipeline templates for build, test, security scanning, and deployment to Kubernetes and serverless runtimes.Partner with application teams to onboard services to Harness, providing guidance, troubleshooting, and best‑practice enablement.Integrate CI/CD pipelines with Infrastructure as Code tooling (e.g., Terraform) and GitOps solutions (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) to support repeatable and auditable deployments.Embed security and compliance controls into CI/CD workflows, including vulnerability scanning, policy enforcement, secrets management, and audit logging to meet HIPAA, SOX, and enterprise security requirements.Collaborate with DevSecOps and Application Security teams to shift security left within the SDLC, leveraging tools such as Trivy, Aqua, or equivalent scanners integrated into Harness pipelines.Monitor platform health, pipeline execution, and application performance using tools such as Dynatrace, Prometheus, and cloud‑native monitoring; perform root cause analysis and drive incident resolution.Participate in code and pipeline reviews, establish platform standards, and ensure adherence to engineering best practices.Enforce platform governance and guardrails using policy‑as‑code approaches (e.g., OPA), ensuring consistency, observability, and compliance across all environments.Act as a technical liaison between the Serverless Platforms Team and partner organizations, translating business and delivery needs into scalable platform capabilities.Communicate platform changes, incident status, and best practices through clear runbooks, release notes, and stakeholder updates; facilitate working sessions to drive alignment and unblock delivery.Stay current with cloud‑native and CI/CD trends, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Cardinal Health’s cloud and DevOps strategy. 

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.3+ years of experience in cloud engineering with a strong focus on Kubernetes and GCP (preferred).Hands‑on experience designing, operating, or supporting CI/CD platforms, preferably Harness CI/CD in an enterprise environment.Strong understanding of microservices, event‑driven architectures, and distributed systems.Experience with GitOps, Infrastructure as Code, and automated delivery pipelines.Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, security scanning, and compliance requirements in regulated environments.Exceptional communication skills—able to translate complex platform and security concepts for both technical and non‑technical audiences, and to influence outcomes through clear documentation and stakeholder alignment.Proven problem‑solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving environments.





Candidates who are back-to-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply. 



Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

description: BUILD A SAFER WORLD. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM’s platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The Data Product team collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly scalable features that power TRM’s products and services. As a Senior Data Engineer on the Data Product team, you will be responsible for designing and building mission-critical data services. These features analyze and provide insights into blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale, and ultimately work to build a safer financial system for billions of people.. The impact you’ll have here: – Build highly scalable features that integrate with dozens of blockchains. – Design and architect intricate data models for optimal storage and retrieval to support sub-second latency for querying blockchain data. – Collaborate across departments, partnering with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design and implement novel data models that enhance TRM’s products. – Collaborate across departments, partnering with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design and implement novel data models that enhance TRM’s products. – You’ll work closely with product managers, data scientists, and customer-facing teams to deeply understand user needs and translate them into scalable data solutions.” – Our best engineers are also exceptional communicators. They write clear design docs, proactively share tradeoffs, and build alignment across disciplines. – Bonus: Experience with LLMs or AI-powered workflows (e.g., prompt engineering, internal tooling, semantic search). What we’re looking for: – Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related field. – A proven track record, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in architecting scalable API development, distributed system architecture, guiding projects from initial ideation through to successful production deployment. – Exceptional programming skills in Python, as well as adeptness in SQL or SparkSQL. – Versatility that spans the entire spectrum of data engineering in one or more of the following areas: – In-depth experience with data stores such as BigQuery and Postgres. – You’ve owned 0–1 systems: building pipelines, data platforms, or ML/BI workflows from scratch—not just maintaining legacy.” – You simplify complexity. You’re skilled at writing and communicating technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. – You’re cost-conscious: you design for performance, scale, and efficiency. – You’ve mentored engineers or analysts and enjoy leveling up those around you – In-depth experience with data stores such as BigQuery and Postgres. – Proficiency in data pipeline and workflow orchestration tools like Airflow and DBT. – Expertise in data processing technologies and streaming workflows including Dataflow, Spark, Kafka, and Flink. – Competence in deploying and monitoring infrastructure within public cloud platforms, utilizing tools such as Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Datadog. – Proven ability in loading, querying, and transforming extensive datasets About the Team: – Our team is spread out over several countries and time zones. To leverage the opportunities and address challenges that come with this working model, we’ve built a culture grounded in trust, transparency, and adaptability. Even though we’re scattered across different time zones, we stay closely connected through open communication and regular check-ins. Our use of digital tools helps us collaborate seamlessly and work at an impressive pace, delivering results at TRM speed while staying in sync. – The diversity of perspectives and expertise within our team sparks creative exchanges and enhances our problem-solving capabilities, allowing us to leverage our global synergy to drive innovation and efficiency. – We’re driven by a deep sense of ownership, constant pursuit of improvement and an obsession with delivering magical experiences to our customers; these are a core part of our culture. – We’re driven by the desire to continuously hone our craft and to this end, we regularly assess our processes, seek feedback, and embrace iterative development to refine what we do. – We structure problems and use the 80/20 rule(for many outcomes, roughly 80% of consequences come from 20% of causes) to identify where to direct our razor-sharp focus. – Each of us is passionate about excellence and growth, and we’re encouraged to challenge the status quo and experiment with new methods. This mindset creates an environment where innovation is part of our daily routine and every team member is an impact-oriented trailblazer. – By celebrating our successes and learning from our setbacks, we stay agile and forward-thinking, always striving to elevate our performance and impact. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: – The team received a request from customers to show the running balance for assets tied to an address within the product. They brainstormed to determine the minimal viable solution that could be delivered within two weeks. The team decided to develop a framework that would facilitate enabling this feature for each chain (such as BTC, ETH, etc.) individually. They successfully implemented and tested this solution for the BTC chain and delivered it to customers within the two-week timeframe. This approach allowed the team to quickly provide value to customers and establish a repeatable process. – The team was tasked with implementing a new feature that would enable TRM to gather feedback from the user community swiftly. Due to the company’s goal of showcasing the feature at an upcoming event, the timeline was tight. The team quickly adjusted to the request, assessed the requirements, and developed a solution that addressed 80% of the needs and could be executed within a very short timeframe. They successfully delivered the feature on schedule, impressing customers with both the functionality and the speed of execution. – The team was tasked with developing a solution to reveal Indirect Exposure through cross-chain swaps in response to a competitor’s similar feature. Before choosing the technical approach, the team consulted with stakeholders to establish a feasible timeline for the implementation. With this input, the team devised a solution that fit the timeline, communicated the tradeoffs to stakeholders, and successfully delivered the solution as promised. About TRM’s Engineering Levels: Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing. Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing. Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor. Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only. The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: – The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $250000. – Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan. APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered. WHAT TO EXPECT FROM OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview. – Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role. – Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. – First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. – Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. – References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact. – Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions. – Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding. Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. Learn more about interviewing at TRM https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/interviewing-at-trm-how-we-hire-and-what-success-looks-like LIFE AT TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.





Netflix is enjoyed by more than 200 million members globally, entertaining new audiences every day. Securing our members data and accounts appropriately is key to maintaining a high level of trust with our customers. In addition, securing our service and guarding against fraudulent behavior is essential to enable us to scale our business effectively.



The Security Data Engineering team builds data products which provide visibility into security and fraud risks across customer accounts as well as internal systems and data. This role is specifically focused on enabling our security teams in detecting and mitigating various types of fraud like account takeovers, unauthorized third party apps, account sharing fraud etc. This requires a holistic understanding of members' activity patterns across various dimensions like geography, device types, content types and more. Centralizing various data points which help us understand these dimensions is key to success in this role.



We are looking for a Data Engineer to build reliable data pipelines and intuitive data products that allow our stakeholders to easily leverage data in an effective manner. As part of this team, you will work on diverse data technologies such as Spark, Presto, Flink, Kafka and others to build insightful, scalable and robust data pipelines; write ETL jobs to collect and aggregate data; and build high quality data models that describe the entities, interactions and usage patterns of the Netflix product.



The ideal candidate will bring a strong track record of having built data systems and frameworks to strengthen the security posture at large consumer businesses. They will have a deep background in distributed data processing and share our passion for continuously improving Netflix's security posture.



Who you are:

Passionate about building intuitive data products to mitigate security and fraud risks

Highly proficient in at least one of Java, Python or Scala with at least 7 years of software/data engineering experience

Advanced level SQL skills in a complex data environment

At least 5 years of experience in engineering data pipelines using big data technologies (Hive, Presto, Spark, Flink) on medium to large scale data sets

Comfortable working cross functionally with multiple types of stakeholders groups

Able to successfully lead large, complex systems design and implementation challenges independently

Prior experience in the security and fraud space is strongly preferre



What you will do:

Engineer efficient, adaptable and scalable data pipelines to process structured and unstructured data

Develop a deep understanding of the security ecosystem at Netflix

Partner with the security engineering teams to understand product goals and provide data which empowers teams to improve our fraud and security posture

Maintain and rethink existing datasets and pipelines

Enable smart analytics by building robust, reliable, and useful data sets that can power various analytic techniques like regression, classification, clustering etc

About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.







About Netwrix Access AnalyzerNetwrix Access Analyzer is a Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platform. It discovers where data lives across enterprise estates—Active Directory and LocalGroups identity, CIFS/SMB file shares, SharePoint Online, and more, and tells security teams what is sensitive data, who can reach it, how, and where that exposure could be dangerous. Our customers are CISOs, compliance and data-governance leaders, and the security analysts who live in the product day to day. They don’t want a data dump; they want answers: who has access to this sensitive share, which groups are stale or over-permissioned, where is data open to everyone, etc.

The Data TeamData’s charter: provide world-class data storage, reporting, analytics, and visualization capabilities that enable customers to understand and act on their data security posture. That means owning the ClickHouse warehouse, the Metabase analytics tier (pre-built and self-service reporting) and the data infrastructure makes sure our application data layer scales as customer data volumes climbs.

You’ll go deep on both the data-engineering side (ClickHouse schema, ingestion correctness, materialized-view performance and scale) and the analytics side (Metabase reporting, embedding, self-service), prioritizing pragmatically rather than splitting attention evenly. You set the technical bar, build the automations and Claude configurations that let anyone (including AI) contribute safely. If you want to own an area end-to-end and shape how it’s built, this is it.

Connectors, the connector framework, or scan logic (what we call Discovery)Detection, classification, risk scoring, and other security posture calculations. You materialize, report, and scale these correctly; you don’t have to author the domain logic that decides what they mean.The PostgreSQL application database. This is a meaningful plus but don’t worry, the center focus remains technical ownership.Data-science / statistics experienceOur StackData warehouse: ClickHouseApplication database: PostgreSQLAnalytics: MetabaseDeployment: Kubernetes via Helm and ArgoCDAI-first tooling: Claude CodeHow We WorkWe are an AI-first engineering team. The expectation isn’t just that you use AI to move faster — it’s that you build your area so that anyone, including AI, can contribute. description:
Job Overview:
The Automotive Dealer Liaison will play a key role in advancing sustainability within a major automotive OEM’s dealership network by driving dealer engagement, fostering participation in a Net Zero Program, and leveraging VECKTA's SaaS platform to implement and monitor energy efficiency initiatives. This individual will serve as a central link between the OEM, dealers, and preferred vendors, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration to achieve carbon reduction goals.


 



 


Key Responsibilities:
Dealer Engagement


Develop and implement strategies to onboard automotive dealers into the Net Zero Program using VECKTA’s SaaS platform.




Drive adoption and maximize retention of participating dealers.




Conduct outreach efforts to educate dealers on the program's benefits and requirements.




Act as a primary point of contact for the OEM’s dealer outreach efforts.




Dealer Action


Ensure identified sustainability initiatives are translated into actionable results by program participants.




Act as a liaison between dealers, the OEM, and preferred vendors to facilitate seamless execution.




Platform Expertise


Utilize in-depth knowledge of VECKTA’s SaaS platform to assist dealers with tracking energy usage and efficiency.




Provide training and ongoing support to dealer staff for effective platform utilization.




Monitoring and Reporting


Collaborate with dealers to track progress toward carbon reduction goals via the VECKTA platform.




Generate reports on dealer performance and program milestones, showcasing the impact of initiatives.




Stakeholder Collaboration


Represent VECKTA in sustainability meetings, ensuring alignment between the OEM’s goals and dealer efforts.




Build strong relationships with various teams to support program objectives.




Sustainability Advocacy


Promote dealer participation through case studies, best practices, and presentations tailored to the dealer network.




Raise awareness of the Net Zero Program through effective communication and promotional materials.




Feedback and Continuous Improvement


Gather and relay feedback from dealers to improve the VECKTA platform and program delivery.




Work closely with VECKTA’s product team to align platform features with the OEM’s and dealers' evolving needs.




Travel and Flexibility


Operate remotely with flexible hours to accommodate U.S. and EU time zones.




Occasional travel, including visiting customers and dealers, as required to support engagement and program execution.




 



 


Required Qualifications:


Proven experience in sustainability, energy efficiency, or related fields.




Strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.




Proficiency in using SaaS platforms for tracking and reporting.




Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities to foster relationships across diverse teams.




Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.




Flexibility to accommodate varying time zones and travel requirements.




 



 


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in automotive dealership operations or networks.




Familiarity with energy efficiency measures and onsite renewable energy projects.




Knowledge of carbon reduction strategies and sustainability reporting.




Location in Western Europe is preferred.




Proficiency in multiple European languages is a plus (English, French, German and/or Italian).

Base salary and performance-based bonuses aligned with VECKTA’s compensation structure.




Reimbursement for travel and approved expenses in line with customer policies.




Comprehensive benefits package, including training opportunities and professional development support.

Role Description




 You'll independently deliver training and technical assistance focused primarily on helping providers navigate Supplemental Security Income and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSI/SSDI) access for the people they serve.  What You'll Do




 
  
   Training Delivery and Facilitation
  
  
   
    Independently deliver training for clinical and non-clinical staff on disability benefits access and other behavioral health programs.
   
   
    Develop training curricula and materials using adult learning principles, and contribute ongoing updates and improvements.
   
   
    Provide coaching and technical assistance to agencies to help improve the quality and success rate of their applications.
   
   
    Collect feedback and outcome data to continuously refine your trainings.

    Maintain working knowledge of SSI/SSDI programs, disability determination processes, and recovery-oriented behavioral health practices.
   
   
    Apply evidence-informed practices and program evaluation findings to how you design and deliver training.
   
   
    Track outcomes and flag opportunities for quality improvement.
   
  
 
 
  
   Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
   
    Build and maintain relationships with behavioral health providers and community organizations to support training implementation.
   
   
    Serve as a day-to-day resource for staff navigating disability benefit processes and best practices.
   
   
    Incorporate input from individuals with lived experience to keep trainings relevant and person-centered.
   
  
 
 
  
   Continuous Improvement and Collaboration
  
  
   
    Contribute to training resources, toolkits, and guides used statewide.
   
   
    Collaborate with fellow trainers to share best practices.
   
   
    Support the standardization of training practices across your assigned programs.
   
  
 


 Qualifications




 
  2–4 years of experience in behavioral health, recovery supports, or related social services.
 
 
  Experience delivering training, coaching, or technical assistance using adult learning principles.
 
 
  Working knowledge of SSI/SSDI and other disability benefit processes.
 
 
  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear training materials.
 
 
  Ability to work independently and manage multiple training engagements at once.
 
 
  Willingness to travel as needed to deliver in-person trainings.
 


 Also Valued




 
  Lived experience navigating disability benefits or behavioral health systems — personally or through a family member — is valued and may substitute for some of the experience above.
 


 Even Better if You Bring

 Benefits

  A flexible work environment and more!

About GRID Alternatives

GRID Alternatives is a national leader in making clean, affordable solar power and solar jobs accessible to low-income communities and communities of color. GRID is an entrepreneurial, high-growth non-profit organization that provides direct solar installation and project development; clean mobility options; workforce training and service-learning opportunities; and low-income solar policy advocacy.

Our Vision: a rapid, equitable transition to a world powered by renewable energy that benefits everyone.

Our Mission: to build community-powered solutions to advance economic and environmental justice through renewable energy.

What it's like to work at GRID…

At GRID, we care about each other and know that each employee has a whole self that includes life outside of work. Our culture supports learning, growth and well-being of all of our team members.

Summary of the role:

GRID Alternatives is looking for a Foundation Development Officer - Colorado, Mid-Atlantic and Mexico to join our national Headquarters Philanthropy team and lead our efforts to increase major, impact-driven funding partnerships from local Colorado, Washington, DC, and Mexico area foundations and manage a current portfolio of partners who have committed to GRID.

Our organization is well-positioned to dramatically increase support from this sector, thanks to rapidly growing interest from the funder community around the intersection of climate change and economic and racial justice, and our status as a growing national nonprofit organization with a proven track record of building community-powered solutions to advance economic and environmental justice through renewable energy.

This is a great opportunity for a superb proposal writer, partnerships thought leader and relationship manager looking for a leadership opportunity.

What you will be doing (essential responsibilities):
• Work directly with the Foundation Development Manager, Colorado Executive Director, Mid-Atlantic Executive Director, and Southern California/Mexico Executive Director to spearhead efforts to raise major 5- to 7-figure funding partnerships from locally based philanthropic foundations, including developing and implementing fundraising and thought leadership strategies
• Manage a portfolio of funders making annual and multi-year grants, including reporting on existing grants, submitting new funding applications, coordinating foundation engagement opportunities, and cultivating long-term relationships
• Provide key thought leadership and drive collaboration with Colorado, Mid-Atlantic, and Southern California leadership on foundation fundraising strategy, case for support development, and identifying opportunities to grow program and organizational capacity through major partnerships
• Serve as a key member of GRID Alternatives’ national fundraising team, including developing long-term fund development strategies and related thought leadership efforts around the importance of equitable renewable energy, workforce development and clean transportation programs
• Promote a Culture of Philanthropy across the organization
• Participate in GRID Colorado/Mid-Atlantic/Southern California affiliate activities to build and strengthen relationships with staff and deepen knowledge about the affiliate’s work and communities

Requirements:

Your areas of knowledge and expertise...
• Passionate advocate for renewable energy, affordable housing, workforce development, and/or environmental justice work
• Ability to develop a prospecting strategy to secure new funders
• 4-5 or more years of professional nonprofit fundraising or grantmaking experience, including a demonstrated track record of managing major 5- to 7-figure foundation and foundation partnerships
• Demonstrated exceptional persuasive writing skills, including both grant writing, oral presentations and email communication
• Excellent organizational skills, follow-through, and attention to detail and deadlines
• Excellent collaboration skills, including the ability to coordinate and communicate effectively and efficiently with a variety of internal team members
• Solid computer productivity skills, including Microsoft Office and Google Apps
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• Comfortable working as part of a team in a hard-working, informal, high-growth organization

Preferred Qualifications
• Bilingual in English and Spanish
• Specific experience with renewable energy, affordable housing, international, and/or environment/environmental justice work
• Existing relationships with local and national foundations that focus on climate change, environmental justice and/or economic opportunity
• Experience working with or in a large, networked organization
• Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM

Compensation:

The compensation range for this fulltime position is $80,000-$90,000. The base pay that will actually be offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.

Benefits:

Medical, Dental, Vision/Eye Care insurance, 5 weeks paid time off (PTO),13 paid holidays, Commuter Checks, 403b Retirement Plan, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), STD, LTD, and AD&D insurance

Where you will sit & the places you may go…

The ideal candidate will sit in a remote location within the United States Preferably the west coast. This position may require up to 25% out-of-town travel to regional offices and special projects such as org-wide celebrations, team building exercises, etc. Availability to work nights and weekends may very rarely be required. GRID Alternatives may provide vehicles for work travel and/or travel reimbursement for personal vehicle use. In this instance, applicants must hold a valid driver’s license and have a good driving record.

Important to note for California applicants:
• *Hired CA candidates must be able to pass a screening for drugs that are illegal in the state of California, including: amphetamine, cocaine metabolite, opiates, and PCP.

Reasonable Accommodation for Job Seekers with a Disability:

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to: RECRUITING@GRIDALTERNATIVES.ORG

Ready to Apply?

Submit a resume describing your interest. Due to the high volume of inquiries, mailed and emailed applications are not accepted.

description:
I’m looking for an experienced sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships professional to help me build and activate a revenue channel around GoodFortune, a founder-led research and intelligence platform.

I’m a senior strategist and founder with 15 years of experience across growth, marketing, organizational strategy, cultural strategy, and institutional transformation. My work has contributed to $5M+ in net-new revenue, $1B+ in enterprise investment mobilized, $24M+ in organizational capital deployment, and significant KPI improvement across enterprise and institutional environments.

GoodFortune builds on that body of work by creating research-driven environments where brands and institutions can learn directly with the communities, practitioners, and leaders they want to understand. Proper Context, my proprietary decision-quality measurement system, structures the intelligence generated through that work.

At this stage, the founder is an important part of the commercial proposition. You are not being asked to sell an unknown event company. You will be selling access to an experienced strategist, a differentiated research methodology, an emerging intelligence platform, and participation formats that allow partners to generate useful insight while creating genuine value for the communities involved.

You can review my background at devtsmith.com.

What We’re Selling

GoodFortune is not primarily selling event sponsorship inventory.

The commercial proposition is research, intelligence, participation, and useful affinity.

Current partnership opportunities include:

Research Partnerships, beginning around $60K, where an organization underwrites research and receives structured intelligence around a strategically important audience, community, market, or decision environment.

Community Insight / Experience Partnerships, where GoodFortune creates facilitated research environments that combine curated participation, strategic conversation, Proper Context measurement, and hospitality.

Larger multi-experience or research series partnerships, currently envisioned in approximately the $180K–$240K range, depending on scope.

Select custom partnerships where a sponsor or institution has a meaningful question GoodFortune is uniquely positioned to investigate.

Partners receive intelligence and strategic learning—not individual participant data or access disguised as research.

The strongest positioning is:

GoodFortune helps organizations build useful affinity with important communities by creating something valuable with them—not simply marketing at them. Proper Context captures what the relationship reveals so the insight can inform what the institution does next.

Initial Engagement

The initial engagement will be a small fixed-fee setup and activation phase, expected to be approximately $500–$800.

This is not a strategy-only assignment.

I want someone who can quickly understand the offering, sharpen the commercial motion where necessary, and begin taking it into market.

The initial work should include:

Review existing sponsorship/research partnership materials and offers

Help identify the strongest initial buyer profiles and sponsorship categories

Build a focused target list of brands, institutions, agencies, foundations, and/or other potential partners

Identify the appropriate decision-makers within those organizations

Prioritize targets based on fit, likelihood, budget, relationship opportunity, and strategic relevance

Refine outreach language where necessary

Establish a practical pipeline and follow-up process

Begin direct outreach and business-development activity

Open qualified conversations with potential partners

Help position and advance opportunities once interest exists

Provide commercial feedback from the market so we can refine packaging without endlessly rebuilding the offer

I do not need a 50-page sponsorship strategy or a giant prospect spreadsheet.

I need somebody who can determine who is most likely to buy this, get us in front of them, and help move the conversation toward revenue.

Longer-Term Opportunity & Compensation

The objective is to develop this into an ongoing fractional sponsorship and partnerships relationship.

My preferred compensation structure is:

Base/fractional compensation + performance upside.

For qualified opportunities you directly source or materially advance, I am currently considering approximately 15% of collected revenue.

Founder-sourced, existing, or house relationships may carry lower commission economics depending on your level of involvement.

Commission would be based on revenue actually collected, not simply proposals submitted or contracts verbally agreed to.

The intent is straightforward:

If you create meaningful revenue, you should participate meaningfully in the upside.

The exact ongoing structure can be finalized with the right person after the initial engagement.

Who I’m Looking For

You should have meaningful experience selling sponsorships, strategic partnerships, research partnerships, experiential partnerships, brand partnerships, or similarly consultative high-value offerings.

I am especially interested in people who have sold to:

Brand marketing leaders

CMOs and senior marketers

Brand partnerships teams

Corporate affairs / social impact leaders

Insights and research leaders

Innovation teams

Agencies

Foundations or institutional funders

Companies seeking meaningful access to creator, professional, cultural, or community audiences

You should be comfortable selling offers worth tens or hundreds of thousands of dollars, where the buyer needs to understand strategic value rather than simply compare CPMs, logos, tables, and ticket inventory.

Strong candidates will understand how to:

Open doors

Find the actual budget owner

Develop relationships

Qualify opportunities

Navigate long enterprise sales cycles

Shape a partnership without immediately discounting it

Advance a buyer from curiosity to a real commercial conversation

Close or materially support closing high-value deals

This role is not lead generation only.

I need someone who understands the difference between giving me a list of names and developing business.

When You Apply

Please briefly tell me:

What kinds of sponsorships or strategic partnerships you have personally sold.

The typical deal sizes you have worked with.

The types of buyers and brands you already understand or have relationships with.

One example of a sponsorship or partnership you personally sourced and helped close.

How you would approach the first 30 days of taking a founder-led research/intelligence offering like this into market.

I’m looking for someone who can eventually become a trusted commercial partner around GoodFortune—not simply someone who sends cold emails.

The goal is to turn an already-developed body of IP, research capability, founder credibility, and partnership inventory into a repeatable sponsorship and strategic-partnership revenue channel.

description:
Job Overview:
The Automotive Dealer Liaison will play a key role in advancing sustainability within a major automotive OEM’s dealership network by driving dealer engagement, fostering participation in a Net Zero Program, and leveraging VECKTA's SaaS platform to implement and monitor energy efficiency initiatives. This individual will serve as a central link between the OEM, dealers, and preferred vendors, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration to achieve carbon reduction goals.


 



 


Key Responsibilities:
Dealer Engagement


Develop and implement strategies to onboard automotive dealers into the Net Zero Program using VECKTA’s SaaS platform.




Drive adoption and maximize retention of participating dealers.




Conduct outreach efforts to educate dealers on the program's benefits and requirements.




Act as a primary point of contact for the OEM’s dealer outreach efforts.




Dealer Action


Ensure identified sustainability initiatives are translated into actionable results by program participants.




Act as a liaison between dealers, the OEM, and preferred vendors to facilitate seamless execution.




Platform Expertise


Utilize in-depth knowledge of VECKTA’s SaaS platform to assist dealers with tracking energy usage and efficiency.




Provide training and ongoing support to dealer staff for effective platform utilization.




Monitoring and Reporting


Collaborate with dealers to track progress toward carbon reduction goals via the VECKTA platform.




Generate reports on dealer performance and program milestones, showcasing the impact of initiatives.




Stakeholder Collaboration


Represent VECKTA in sustainability meetings, ensuring alignment between the OEM’s goals and dealer efforts.




Build strong relationships with various teams to support program objectives.




Sustainability Advocacy


Promote dealer participation through case studies, best practices, and presentations tailored to the dealer network.




Raise awareness of the Net Zero Program through effective communication and promotional materials.




Feedback and Continuous Improvement


Gather and relay feedback from dealers to improve the VECKTA platform and program delivery.




Work closely with VECKTA’s product team to align platform features with the OEM’s and dealers' evolving needs.




Travel and Flexibility


Operate remotely with flexible hours to accommodate U.S. and EU time zones.




Occasional travel, including visiting customers and dealers, as required to support engagement and program execution.




 



 


Required Qualifications:


Proven experience in sustainability, energy efficiency, or related fields.




Strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.




Proficiency in using SaaS platforms for tracking and reporting.




Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities to foster relationships across diverse teams.




Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.




Flexibility to accommodate varying time zones and travel requirements.




 



 


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in automotive dealership operations or networks.




Familiarity with energy efficiency measures and onsite renewable energy projects.




Knowledge of carbon reduction strategies and sustainability reporting.




Location in Western Europe is preferred.




Proficiency in multiple European languages is a plus (English, French, German and/or Italian).




 



 


Compensation and Benefits:


Base salary and performance-based bonuses aligned with VECKTA’s compensation structure.




Reimbursement for travel and approved expenses in line with customer policies.




Comprehensive benefits package, including training opportunities and professional development support.
